{{Quote|This carnivorous predator can swallow 15 times its body weight.|Lyrre T'enna's notes on the Dagobah python|<ref name="Wild" />}}
The '''Dagobah python''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] [[Snake/Legends|snake]] native to the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. The creatures consisted mostly of a huge [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]] and a huge [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] and hunted by dropping on prey from low [[Gnarltree/Legends|gnarltree]] branches and crushing them before consuming them. The [[Intergalactic Zoological Society]] at one point captured a Dagobah python, and the [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologist]] [[Lyrre T'enna]] also encountered the species, making notes and sketches of them which were included in [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Lyrre T'enna's annotated field guide|annotated field guide]].

==Biology and appearance==
Dagobah pythons were a primitive [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Snake/Legends|snake]] native to the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. Their bodies primarily consisted of a large [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] leading to an even larger [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]],<ref name="ff" /> allowing them to swallow up to fifteen times their own body weight. Their mouths were filled with sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] and located on the pythons' relatively small heads below a pair of [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Wild" /> The snakes' gnarled and knobbly bodies<ref name="ff" /> were long and gray, with a relatively thick midsections leading into much thinner posterior and anterior sections of the body.<ref name="Wild" />

==Behavior==
{{Quote|The python hunts by draping itself on low branches and waiting.|Field notes made by Lyrre T'enna on the python's hunting technique|<ref name="Wild" />}}
[[Diet/Legends|Carnivorous]] and predatory in nature, the pythons would hunt by draping themselves across the lower branches<ref name="Wild" /> of [[Gnarltree/Legends|gnarltrees]]<ref name="MTCOD">{{SW|url=news/meet-the-creatures-of-dagobah|text=Meet the Creatures of Dagobah|nolive=1}}</ref> and waiting for prey to pass below or fly nearby.<ref name="Wild" /> When any creature did enter the area under the snake, the predator would be ready to pounce and drop down, winding its long body around the prey, swiftly crushing the life from them. Once the python's victim was [[Death/Legends|dead]], the snake would consume it, and then become docile while digesting it.<ref name="ff" /> Airborne prey of the python, such as the [[Smooka/Legends|spade-headed smooka]], could simply be plucked from the air by the snake's toothy maw.<ref name="Wild" />

==History==
[[File:Dagobah_python_2.png|thumb|left|Dagobah pythons preyd upon spade-headed smookas.|150px]]
By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], at least one Dagobah python had been discovered and captured by the [[Intergalactic Zoological Society]]. The python was transported in a large container onboard the ''[[Titavian IV]]'', one of the society's exploration vessels, while the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was returning to the planet [[Mycroft]], where the society was based. The ship never reached it destination however, as it was boarded and all of its crew killed, leaving the vessel drifting in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] later boarded the vessel and passed the snake's container while he was there investigating a distress signal being transmitted by another [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], who was hiding on board the ship.<ref name="R69">[[Republic 69|''Republic'' 69]]</ref>

During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologist]] [[Lyrre T'enna]] encountered Dagobah pythons while in the field on Dagobah, and included sketches and notes concerning the species in [[Gender/Legends|her]] field journals. The journals, including the pages showing the pythons, were later compiled into an [[Lyrre T'enna's annotated field guide|annotated field guide]] with some input from the Intergalactic Zoological Society.<ref name="Wild" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dagobah python was created in [[2001]] for ''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]'', a reference book written by [[Bob Carrau]] and [[Terryl Whitlatch]], the latter of whom also illustrated it. The images from the guide were then included along with some new information in ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' issue [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 91|91]] in a section on Dagobah wildlife. A python also then made a brief appearance in the background of [[Republic 69|''Republic'' 69]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] released in [[2004]] which was illustrated by [[Jan Duursema]] and included several other species originating from the ''The Wildlife of Star Wars''. In [[2014]] they received mention in ''[[Meet the Creatures of Dagobah]]'', a post on [[StarWars.com]] written by [[Tim Veekhoven]].
